name: Finding Your Mate
overview: Scripture reveals that God created companionship as essential for mankind, declaring it is not good for man to be alone and providing a suitable helper for him. The union of marriage is established as a sacred bond where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife, becoming one flesh. Trusting the Lord wholeheartedly and delighting in Him are key to receiving the desires of the heart, including finding a spouse. Moreover, finding a wife is portrayed as a blessing and favor from the Lord, highlighting the value of partnership, as two working together achieve greater rewards than one alone.
